name: benign_update_with_son
label: benign
description: A real software update fills the screen while her son, on the phone, tells her not to turn the computer off. A full-screen takeover plus 'don't turn it off', and nothing else.

call.speaker: senior
call.text: David, the computer has gone all blue and says installing updates.

call.speaker: caller
call.text: That's normal, Mum. It's just Windows updating. Don't turn it off, let it finish.

call.speaker: caller
call.text: Maybe ten minutes. Make a cup of tea and it'll be done. Call me back if it gets stuck.
